title: Missing navigation landmark
user_impact: Screen reader users cannot jump straight to the navigation.
technical_impact: No element with role="navigation" (implicit via <nav> or explicit) present.
source: WAI-ARIA 1.2 navigation role; ARIA Authoring Practices, Landmark Regions; review for SC 1.3.1/2.4.1
applicability: Every top-level document. A body without any content has nothing to structure and is not applicable.
expectation:
Asks for review when the document has no rendered navigation landmark (nav or
role="navigation"). A page may legitimately have no navigation (a single
delivery note, a consent wall), so this is an expectation, not a failure. When
the desktop and the mobile navigation are separate elements shown per
breakpoint, each viewport has one: nothing to report. One review at the html
element.
